sample_facts.fact: Lumentum reported fiscal Q4 2026 net revenue of $1.01 billion.
Lumentum reported fiscal Q4 2026 GAAP gross margin of 47.4% and non-GAAP gross margin of 50.4%.
Lumentum reported fiscal Q4 2026 GAAP operating margin of 27.8% and non-GAAP operating margin of 36.6%.
Lumentum guided fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $1.225 billion to $1.275 billion.
Lumentum guided fiscal Q1 2027 non-GAAP operating margin of 39.5% to 40.5% and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.05 to $4.35.
Lumentum said it received an initial order for ELS modules and cited growing demand for ultra-high-power CPO lasers.
Lumentum said it is advancing 1.6T adoption in its cloud module business and that OCS solutions and cloud modules are beginning to layer in as growth drivers.
Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston warned that the InP supply-demand gap has surpassed that of DRAM and NAND, making it a critical constraint on AI data center optical interconnect expansion.
